name: The End Of Time
overview: Scripture reveals that the end of time will be marked by significant spiritual outpouring and unprecedented tribulation. God will pour out His Spirit broadly, enabling prophecy, dreams, and visions among all people, signaling the nearness of the end (Joel 2:28). Jesus taught that the gospel must be preached worldwide before the end comes, and that believers must endure faithfully to be saved amidst great tribulation unlike any before (Matthew 24:13-14, 21). Yet, the exact day and hour remain known only to the Father, emphasizing the need for watchfulness and steadfast faith (Matthew 24:36).
